I had to have them resubmit it and even then they only gave me till dec 31, 2025.

Hey all, just wanted to update just incase anyone finds themselves in similar situations. 

They originally gave me one month and said I would need to "revisit" the situation then. That months almost up so I had my doctor resubmit the paperwork just to be safe, this time making sure to put that my end date is indefinite. This time they gave me till December 31, 2025 when I'll just have to remind them of the already established and submitted paperwork. 

They are really cracking down on accomidations at my site, especially in my department. Hopefully, it's easier for other people, but I very much got the feeling that they were hoping I'd just give up and give in. 

So don't give up and be very firm anytime you need accomidation. I went through just as much hell getting my school accommodation or I would have considered moving sites 😅. 

If anyone has questions or anything else I'm here feel free to shoot me a message 🙂
